Add to your rack

Big plans or tiny to-dos. They all count.

Welcome to your lane

Add a task to load a ball. Adjust aim and power, then roll to randomly reveal one of your tasks. The ring you land in sets its points.

Finish the revealed task and hit “Complete & bank” to claim those points. A miss is worth 10 effort points. You can roll other tasks while one is in progress.

Your rack and score are stored in this browser on this device.
